# YourGP@Lyneham

> General practice medical clinic in Lyneham, Canberra. Part of the YourGP group with locations in Lyneham, Crace, and Denman Prospect. Vision: Genuine Care, Clinical Excellence.

## Website Information

- URL: https://yourgplyneham.com.au
- Practice: YourGP@Lyneham
- Phone: (02) 6109 0000
- Fax: (02) 6109 0001
- Booking System: HotDoc (online appointment booking)
- HealthLink EDI: yourgpat

## Locations

### YourGP@Lyneham (Primary)
- Address: 62 Brigalow Street, Lyneham ACT 2602 (next to Tilley's café)
- Hours: Monday–Thursday 8am–6pm, Friday 8am–12pm

### YourGP@Crace
- Address: 1/5 Baratta Street, Crace ACT 2911
- Hours: Monday–Friday 8am–6pm, Saturday 9am–1pm

### YourGP@Denman
- Address: Level 1, 1B Felstead Vista, Denman Prospect ACT 2611
- Hours: Monday–Friday 8am–6pm

## Pages

### Home
- Path: /
- Description: Practice overview with vision statement, opening hours, Google Maps embed, and online appointment booking via HotDoc. Three surgery locations listed.

### Doctors
- Path: /doctors
- Description: Staff directory with 8 doctors listed with photos, backgrounds, qualifications, and availability. Includes accepting-new-patients status indicators and work day schedules per location. Doctors include Dr Mano Selvanathan, Dr Belinda Glasson, Dr Raymond Liu, Dr Riana JvR, Dr Fred Chung, Dr John Deery, Dr Freya Ashman.

### Services
- Path: /services
- Description: 16 medical services with expandable descriptions — Children's Health, Childhood Immunisations, Chronic Disease Management, Driver's Medicals, Men's Health, Women's Health, Mental Health, Minor Procedures (IUD insertion, tongue tie), Musculoskeletal care, Travel Vaccinations, Skin Checks, Vasectomy, Workers Compensation, After Hours care. Allied Health includes Nursing and Pathology.

### New Patient
- Path: /patient
- Description: Patient registration information with online form link. Billing details with four consultation levels (B through E). Saturday clinic info at YourGP@Crace. After-hours care options — CALMS (1300 422 567), Healthdirect (1800 022 222), Saturday morning clinic, urgent after-hours care (prepaid $300). Embedded JotForm for after-hours booking.

### FAQ
- Path: /faq
- Description: 15 frequently asked questions covering appointments, urgent bookings, billing, parking, languages and interpreters, confidentiality, medical certificates, results, contacting doctors, repeat prescriptions, email, reminders, after-hours care, accreditation, teaching practice, complaints, and privacy policy.

### Contact
- Path: /contact
- Description: Contact methods (online form, phone, fax), opening hours by location, after-hours contact, prescription and referral request links, all three location addresses, Google Maps embed, and HealthLink EDI.

### Careers
- Path: /careers
- Description: Recruitment for GPs (sole traders), Nurses, and Admin staff. Practice values and culture description. RACGP Award recognition. Microsoft Forms application link.

### Privacy Policy
- Path: /privacy-policy
- Description: Full YourGP privacy policy. Reviewed February 2026. PDF version available.

## Key Facts

- Billing: Private billing (no bulk billing). Fees vary by consultation level and day.
- After Hours: CALMS 1300 422 567, Healthdirect 1800 022 222, urgent after-hours care prepaid $300
- Saturday Clinic: Available at YourGP@Crace 9am–1pm
- Accreditation: AGPAL accredited
- Teaching Practice: Trains GP registrars
- Patient Volume: 100,000+ annual patient visits across all locations
